entries.title: Compare two gadgets
entries.description: Example prompt. Compare the differences that matter for your own use.
entries.prompt:
Help me compare [product A] and [product B] for [my main use]. My budget is [amount] and I am buying in [country].

Ask me any essential questions first. Check current official specifications and distinguish confirmed facts from uncertain information. Explain the practical tradeoffs, total cost and compatibility. Finish with which product fits my needs better and what would change that recommendation.

entries.title: Understand a tech feature
entries.description: Example prompt. Turn an unfamiliar tech term into something practical.
entries.prompt: Explain [technology or feature] in plain language. Begin with the problem it solves, use one everyday example, and explain the main limitation. Tell me who benefits and which claims I should verify before buying a product because of this feature.
